name: after-effects-claude-mcp
description: Let Claude build and edit Adobe After Effects motion graphics for you.
long_description: Build SaaS-explainer style motion graphics in Adobe After Effects by chatting: 3D camera rigs, eased moves, matched cuts, word-by-word text reveals, shape-built UI and frame checks. Needs Adobe After Effects on this computer, with Settings > Scripting & Expressions > 'Allow Scripts to Write Files and Access Network' turned on.
